scope: Disposition of every normalized main-text difference region, with semantic exclusions retained. This does not establish whole-source admission, publisher-byte authenticity or semantic compilation.

dispositions.async-functions: The async method modifier and anonymous-function asyncopt markers are implemented through independently selected capabilities. Source-local ref/out formals (CSN2052), semicolon-bodied async methods (CSN2053) and async partial methods are checked. Task types, return-type validity, evaluation and cross-part partial-method modifier matching remain excluded semantics.
dispositions.await-expressions: await-expression is a unary-expression and statement-expression in async function bodies only. Placement restrictions (CSN2050), raw await identifiers (CSN2051) and direct lambda/query operands (CSN2030) are checked; awaitability, task identity and suspension remain excluded semantics.
dispositions.generic-member-transcription: Main text now prints type-argument-listopt for member-access and pointer-member-access, matching the existing generic member and generic pointer-member syntax admitted since CSharp2.
dispositions.preprocessing-trailing-comment: Adds #endregion to the directives that may end with a single-line comment. The existing pp-message reading of region text already accepts that comment.
dispositions.modifier-compatibility: A modifier/initializer combination rule for events. General modifier compatibility remains an inherited explicit exclusion of the normalized contract.
dispositions.caller-info-attributes: Caller info attributes change compiler argument substitution and #line effects only; attribute syntax is unchanged. Substitution remains an excluded semantic.
dispositions.field-and-layout-normalization: Equal after normalizing resolved versus unresolved cross-reference fields, Word index (XE) and DOCPROPERTY fields, typographic quotes/dashes, NFKC and table/paragraph layout.
dispositions.retained-semantic-or-editorial-boundary: Inspected difference adds no normalized token/owner category: wording, examples, tables of contents or changes to binding, conversions, inference, definite assignment, expansions, events, constructors, runtime or compiler behavior remain within the inherited exclusions.
